question.text: A sample of red ink (a colloidal suspension) is prepared by mixing eosine dye, egg white, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>HCHO</mi></math> and water. The component which ensures stability of the ink sample is :

solution.text: Blue ink is a colloidal sol, so it can be stabilised by material like natural gum or Egg white/albumen.
